title: God is merciful yet also just
source_text: II. Porro Deus natura quidem ad hoc propensus est ut miseris succurrat, verum non misericors solum, sed & justus est, ac quemadmodum misericordia ut peccatori ignoscat compellit, ita postulat justitia ne peccatum impunitum sinat, sed legum suarum vim & majestatem tueatur, poenam de peccatis sumendo.
pass_a_gloss: God is indeed by nature inclined to help the miserable, yet he is not only merciful but also just; and just as mercy presses him to forgive the sinner, so justice demands that he not leave sin unpunished, but uphold the force and majesty of his laws by taking punishment for sins.
pass_b_english: God’s nature is merciful toward the wretched, yet also just.
Mercy urges pardon; justice forbids leaving sin unpunished.
